The 4061 is also sold factory-terminated in TA4F, 3-pin LEMO, or locking 3.5mm (Sennheiser-style) mini-jack instead of MicroDot/MicroLock, selected at time of purchase.

Phantom-powered 11-52 VDC (2.0 mA draw, per Shure's official spec sheet; B&H lists 12-48V in descriptive copy) supplied over this same connector by the downstream mixer/interface -- there is no separate power connector on this device. The mic capsule's attached ~3.7 m (12 ft) cable terminates in a proprietary Shure 4-pin mini connector that mates with the included preamplifier; this is a fixed, non-user-facing internal connection (not one of the supported connector ids) and is not modeled as a separate port here.

ports.name: Audio Output

ports.name: Network

ports.name: Network

Without PoE+ (e.g. only PoE), device works as mic only — loudspeaker is disabled.

ports.name: Mic In (5-Pin)
ports.note: Manufacturer labels this a 5-pin LEMO port for dual-channel XLR microphone input; requires a separately available LEMO-to-dual-XLR3 breakout cable. LEMO is not in the connector list, so xlr5 (nearest 5-pin audio connector) is used as an approximation.

ports.name: DC In
ports.note: 2-pin LEMO power input, 6.8V–16.8V DC (bundled LEMO power cable included). LEMO is not in the connector list; dc-barrel used as nearest external-DC-input analog — actual connector is a 2-pin LEMO, not a coaxial barrel jack.

ports.name: DC Out (Aux Power)
ports.note: 2-pin LEMO auxiliary power output, 12V DC, for powering accessories. Same LEMO-vs-barrel approximation as DC In.

ports.name: LANC Remote
ports.note: 2.5mm sub-mini jack, Sony LANC-compatible remote control (incl. power on/off). 2.5mm is not in the connector list; trs-3.5 used as nearest TRS-jack analog — actual jack is smaller (2.5mm, not 3.5mm).

ports.name: Serial Port 1
ports.note: One of two 4-pin LEMO "Camera Interface" control ports (per B&H spec table) for accessory/camera control. Physical connector is a 4-pin LEMO, not a DB9/RS232 jack; rs232 used as nearest serial-control connector id since no LEMO option exists.

ports.name: Serial Port 2
ports.note: Second of two identical 4-pin LEMO camera-control serial ports; same approximation as Serial Port 1.

ports.name: Out 1/2
ports.note: Physical connector is TA-5M (mini-XLR 5-pin), closest listed id used; carries output buses 1 and 2.

ports.name: Out 3/4
ports.note: TA-5M; carries output buses 3 and 4.

ports.name: Out 5/6
ports.note: TA-5M; carries output buses 5 and 6.

ports.name: Ret 1/2
ports.note: TA-5 camera-return/line-level input pair (also usable as line inputs 7-8).

ports.name: Ret 3/4
ports.note: TA-5 camera-return/line-level input pair (also usable as line inputs 9-10).

ports.name: Slate
ports.note: External slate/com microphone input, 5V-biased balanced/unbalanced.

ports.name: AES In/Out
ports.note: Physically a mini DB-15 (DE-15) connector carrying AES3 digital audio, not video; 4 AES input pairs (incl. 1 AES42 pair) + 3 AES output pairs share this single connector.

ports.name: Power
ports.note: Physical connector is a 4-pin Hirose (not XLR-shelled); accepts 10-18 VDC external power. xlr4-dc used as closest listed 4-pin locking DC connector id.

ports.name: ZaxNet
ports.note: Actual connector is SMA-female (2.4-2.475 GHz ZaxNet RF antenna, transmit or receive); no SMA id exists in the allowed list, BNC used as closest RF coax substitute.

ports.name: Serial
ports.note: USB-A shaped but wired as Zaxcom-proprietary RS-422 serial, not USB data; used to connect Zaxcom Oasis, FP8 fader panel, Mix-8 control panel, or GPI Remote Roll switch via adapter cables.

ports.name: USB
ports.note: Nomad 8 and 12 only. Used for recording to USB drives or attaching a USB keyboard.

ports.name: Media Port 1 (SDI In)
ports.note: 75 ohm; supports SDI (SMPTE 259M), HD-SDI (SMPTE 292M), 3G-SDI (SMPTE 424M) with embedded digital audio

ports.name: Media Port 1 (SDI Loop Out)
ports.note: Reclocked, amplified loop-through of Media Port 1 input

ports.name: Media Port 2 (SDI In)
ports.note: 75 ohm; supports SDI/HD-SDI/3G-SDI with embedded digital audio

ports.name: Media Port 2 (SDI Loop Out)
ports.note: Reclocked, amplified loop-through of Media Port 2 input

ports.name: Coax Output
ports.note: QAM RF CATV output, up to 2 frequency-agile channels (CATV ch 2-135), +25 to +45 dBmV; connector style inferred from rear-panel photo (matches SDI BNC style), not explicitly labeled by ZeeVee as BNC vs F-type

ports.name: Alert Media
ports.note: Present on rear panel per ZeeVee's own configuration guide; labeled 'this function not implemented yet' as of guide publication; connector shape inferred from panel photo, not textually confirmed

ports.name: Delay Matched Audio Out
ports.note: Delay-matched analog stereo audio output for external audio system; first port (Media Port 1) only, requires analog audio as input

ports.name: Event Detection
ports.note: Green pluggable terminal block visible on rear panel; labeled 'this function not implemented yet' in ZeeVee's configuration guide; likely GPI/contact-closure input

ports.name: LAN 1
ports.note: 10/100 Mb Ethernet, for configuration and remote management

ports.name: LAN 2
ports.note: 10/100 Mb Ethernet, symmetrical with LAN 1

ports.name: AC Input
ports.note: IEC 60320 C14 inlet, 100-240 VAC 50/60 Hz, 60W max / 30W typical

ports.name: Media Transport (10Gb Ethernet, PoE Enabled)
ports.note: 10Gb AVoIP media/audio/control transport link to switch; PoE-powered variant possible

ports.name: Utility (10/100/1Gb)
ports.note: Management/control Ethernet port for ZyPer Management Platform

ports.name: USB
ports.note: USB 2.0 Type-A host port; USB HID pass-through paired with an XS/XR encoder

ports.name: AUD-OUT
ports.note: Unbalanced stereo analog audio output; digital audio (encoded formats + LPCM up to 8ch) embedded via HDMI

ports.name: Power
ports.note: 12V DC locking barrel connector; external AC power supply included

ports.name: HDMI 2.0 Output
ports.note: Labeled "Media Output / HDMI 2.0 OUT" on copper sibling panel; identical on fiber variant. HDCP pass-through, embedded audio up to 8ch LPCM.

ports.name: Audio Out
ports.note: Unbalanced stereo analog breakout, labeled "AUD-OUT" on panel.

ports.name: USB
ports.note: Single USB 2.0 Type-A; used to extend USB/HID between paired ZyPer4K-XS/XR encoder and decoder.

ports.name: 1 Gb Utility Port
ports.note: Utility/control Ethernet, separate from the main 10G media link.

ports.name: Media Transport (Fiber)
ports.note: 10Gb fiber port for video/audio/control, via hot-swappable SFP+ cage; replaces the copper model's 10Gb PoE RJ45 port. Requires a ZeeVee SFP+ transceiver module (multimode ~300m or single-mode ~10-20km), not bundled.

ports.name: Power In
ports.note: 12V DC, locking (twist-lock) barrel connector; ~8W consumption. External AC power supply included in box.

ports.name: USB
ports.note: Datasheet specifies a single Mini USB 2.0 Type B port (for USB pass-through between paired ZyPer4K-XS/XR encoder/decoder units); Mini-B isn't in the connector enum, approximated as usb-micro. Included cable is USB Type-A on the host end.

ports.name: Utility (10/100/1Gb)
ports.note: 1Gb management/utility port, separate from the media-transport network port.

ports.name: 10Gb Ethernet (Media Transport, PoE)
ports.note: 10Gbit copper (Cat6a, 100m) port carrying video/audio/control; PoE-enabled per rear-panel silkscreen.

ports.name: Power (12V DC)
ports.note: Rear panel shows a locking 12V DC, 1.2A power connector (not a plain barrel jack); dc-barrel is the closest enum match. External power supply included in box.

ports.name: HDMI Out
ports.note: HDMI 2.0a with HDCP 2.2 pass-through; also carries multi-channel digital audio (LPCM up to 8ch, Dolby Digital, AC3)

ports.name: Media Transport (1Gb Ethernet, PoE)
ports.note: Carries compressed video/audio/control over IP; device can be powered via PoE on this port

ports.name: Audio Out
ports.note: Balanced stereo analog audio output via Phoenix/captive-screw terminal block (L+/L-/GR+/GR-)

ports.name: RS-232
ports.note: Full duplex serial up to 115.2 kbps via Phoenix terminal block (TX/RX/G) for display/source control

ports.name: USB Host
ports.note: Dual USB 2.0 Type A host ports (device has 2x USB-A per datasheet)

ports.name: IR In
ports.note: 3.5mm mini-jack IR input

ports.name: IR Out
ports.note: 3.5mm mini-jack IR output

ports.name: Power
